notes.path: Python interpreter path. Can be absolute path or just 'python' to use system PATH
notes.totalSegmentatorPath: Path to TotalSegmentator source directory (optional if pip installed)
notes.device: Options: 'gpu', 'cpu', 'mps', or 'gpu:X' where X is GPU device ID
notes.fast: Use faster 3mm resolution model instead of 1.5mm
notes.ml: Output multilabel NIfTI file instead of separate files per class
notes.hu_threshold: When exporting mesh from an intensity volume (CT HU), use this iso-value threshold
notes.volume_gaussian_sigma: Optional Gaussian smoothing (in voxel units) before marching cubes for intensity volumes; 0 disables
